description: This file contains unit tests for the BigUnsigned class in the Abseil library, specifically testing the ShiftLeft, MultiplyBy, MultiplyByBigUnsigned, and power functions like MultiplyByFiveToTheNth and MultiplyByTenToTheNth.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: A template class representing arbitrary-precision unsigned integers used in the tests.

methods.name: ShiftLeft
methods.description: Shifts the BigUnsigned number left by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: MultiplyBy
methods.description: Multiplies the BigUnsigned number by a uint32_t or another BigUnsigned.

methods.name: MultiplyByFiveToTheNth
methods.description: Multiplies the BigUnsigned number by 5 raised to the power N.

methods.name: MultiplyByTenToTheNth
methods.description: Multiplies the BigUnsigned number by 10 raised to the power N.
